hints.title: Algebraic Outlier Equation
hints.text: If total sum of array is T and x is the outlier, the remaining elements sum to 2S where S is the sum element.

hints.title: Parity and Target Sum
hints.text: For x to be an outlier, T - x must be an even integer, and target S = (T - x) // 2 must exist in the array.

hints.title: Frequency Check
hints.text: Ensure that S is present with sufficient multiplicity in a frequency map when x is temporarily removed.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash map frequency lookup verifies whether the required sum element exists for each candidate outlier.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise testing of all candidate outlier and sum combinations requires O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary hash table allows O(1) frequency lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derives the algebraic relation S = (total_sum - x) / 2 and checks frequency counts.
